name: mirage
text: Measured, warm scan (15,300 priced lines): still 45% of requests skipped for 'no fair line'. I traced real legs: Sunday NFL/college game lines are priced (one side was missed, fixed). The big missing group is PLAYER PROP ALTERNATE LADDERS: Novig lists receiving yards at 10.5, 17.5, 24.5, 29.5... but the books carry the main number (e.g. 49.5) and a few rungs, so most rungs have no book price to copy. APIs aren't failing; they simply don't post those rungs. The fix is a ladder model: price an unposted rung from the posted ones for the same player (normal curve through the books' lines), with a premium. I'm building that now, plus checking why 20% of requests are still skipped as 'two legs in one game'.
